assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE transparent middle-depth parallax overlay for the provided industrial bio-laboratory 2D fighting stage, 1600 x 900 landscape. Input image is ONLY a strict reference for camera, realistic painted materials, lighting and palette. Do not reproduce the full laboratory. Add slender peripheral utility details: a corroded steel service conduit and a small bolted connection box along the extreme LEFT edge, with a tiny red caged status lamp; a pair of narrow amber-brown fluid hoses and their metal clamps hugging the extreme RIGHT edge. All visible geometry must stay within x=0..135 or x=1465..1600; most fittings partly crop offscreen. Lower ends terminate near source y=735. Match dark desaturated concrete/steel surroundings, green tank bounce on inward-facing edges and restrained red warning-light reflection. Straight-on side-view, realistic game environment paint quality. No new tank, statue, platform, full column, wall or central structure. Entire x=160..1440 must be fully transparent top to bottom. No floor plane, opaque shadows, mist, people, creatures, text, labels, UI or painted checkerboard. Output only this one sparse compositable RGBA overlay with genuine alpha.

visual_review.observations: Sparse lateral utility details and low corner debris. Central fighting band is clear. Existing tank, statues, tents, booths and ferris wheel are not duplicated. No character, text, UI or opaque background.
